image_description: Two toddlers sitting on a patterned surface. The child in the foreground wears a pink long-sleeved shirt and a blue diaper with visible white adhesive tabs on the side. The child in the background wears a grey patterned outfit. A colorful toy is partially visible on the right.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular when flat, with elasticized leg openings and waistband.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The diaper is worn, not flat, but the silhouette clearly shows the waistband wrapping around the torso and the distinct curve of the leg openings fitting the child's thighs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thickness is notably padded and bulky when uncompressed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The garment exhibits significant volume between the legs and around the hips, consistent with the padded bulk of a disposable diaper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Folded form shows layered construction with absorbent core between layers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The diaper is being worn by a child, so the internal layered construction of the absorbent core is not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fastening system uses adhesive tabs (hook-and-loop or sticky) on side panels.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: White rectangular adhesive tabs are clearly visible on the right hip area of the blue diaper, securing the front panel to the back.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elastic creates gathered ruffles at leg cuffs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Subtle gathering and ruffling are visible along the inner thigh line where the diaper meets the skin, indicating elasticized leg cuffs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Size indicators and wetness strip may be visible.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No specific size numbers or color-changing wetness indicator strips are discernible on the visible outer surface of the diaper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Outer surface is smooth plastic or fabric-like material in white or printed patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The blue outer shell appears smooth with a slight sheen, typical of the waterproof plastic/fabric composite used in diapers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Inner surface is soft non-woven fabric.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The inner lining is completely occluded by the child's body and the folded nature of the worn garment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Absorbent padded core with waterproof outer layer.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the core itself isn't seen, the external bulk and the smooth, water-resistant appearance of the outer layer confirm the presence of this standard structural composition.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the object classification and distinguish it from other infant garments like underwear or training pants.
To audit the anatomical correctness of the children's limbs and posture, ensuring no AI-generated structural deformities in the primary subjects.
To check for boundary bleeding or fusion between the diaper, the children's skin, and the background bedding.
To assess general texture consistency and look for subtle generation artifacts in skin tones and fabric patterns.

focus_areas: Child limb anatomy and joint connections
Boundary separation between diaper and skin
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the diaper tabs and the main body of the diaper; AI often fails to render the mechanical connection of adhesive tabs realistically. Also, scrutinize the children's hands and fingers for common AI deformation artifacts.
